description: 国王弃兵 C33 — Kf1特殊王步，不易位的正例

intro.popup:
练习第10局
国王弃兵 KGA
特殊情况：王不易位！
Kf1主动王步
当子力极其活跃时
王可以作为攻击参与者
这是不易位的正例——每条规则都有例外！
intro.popup_en:
Practice Game 10
King's Gambit Accepted
An exception: White does not castle. The active king move Kf1 can be safe when White's pieces are highly active and the king can participate in the attack. This is a specific example, not a general rule: every principle has exceptions.

outro.popup:
不易位的特殊情况
国王弃兵经典变化：
① Kf1主动，保护f2格
② 子力极度活跃：Bc4，Nf3，Nc3
③ 黑后被困在h6，难以参战
④ Nxf4完成中心整合

什么时候可以不易位？
子力协调 + 王位置安全 + 对手慢
缺一不可！
outro.popup_en: A special case for delaying castling: Kf1 protects f2, White's pieces are active on c4, f3, and c3, Black's queen is stranded on h6, and Nxf4 restores the pawn while centralizing the knight. Not castling is viable only when the pieces are coordinated, the king is safe, and the opponent is slow; all three conditions matter.

moves.popup_en: e4 opens the game and occupies the center.
...e5 mirrors White's central advance.

moves.popup:
f4！国王弃兵！
白方送出f兵，换取中心控制
moves.popup_en: f4! The King's Gambit offers the f-pawn in exchange for central control and rapid development.
...exf4 accepts the gambit pawn.
Bc4 develops the bishop immediately and targets f7.

moves.popup:
Qh4+！黑后早出！
将军！这是一手进攻但也是冒险
moves.popup_en: ...Qh4+! Black brings the queen out early with check. It is an aggressive try, but also a risk.

moves.popup:
Kf1！！特殊王步！
王主动走到f1，不走到g2
这是强手！
① 王到f1，不易位也安全
② 阻止了黑后的进攻节奏
③ g1的车将来可以在g列发力
moves.popup_en: Kf1!! An unusual but strong king move. White steps to f1 rather than g2, avoids further queen checks, and keeps the rook on h1 ready to become active along the g-file. Here the king can be safe without castling.
...Nf6 develops a knight and attacks the center.
Nf3 develops and drives the black queen away.

moves.popup:
Qh6黑后撤到h6
后在h6位置很被动
moves.popup_en: ...Qh6 retreats, but the queen is passive on h6 and may struggle to rejoin the game.
d4 claims more central space.
...d6 reinforces Black's position.
Nc3 develops another piece and supports the center.
...c6 supports the center and prepares a solid pawn structure.

moves.popup:
e5中心推进！
压制黑方f6马
moves.popup_en: e5! White advances in the center and restricts Black's knight on f6.
...dxe5 captures the advanced pawn.
dxe5 recaptures and keeps White's central presence.
...Nd5 centralizes the knight and challenges White's pieces.
Bxd5 removes the centralized knight.
...cxd5 recaptures the bishop.
Nxd5 centralizes White's knight.
...Nc6 develops the knight and seeks counterplay.

moves.popup:
Nxf4！白马吃回弃兵！
① 赢回了f4兵，物质平衡
② 马在f4极其活跃
③ 黑后在h6毫无作为
④ 白王在f1：特殊但安全！

子力协调 > 形式安全
这就是不易位特例的精髓！
moves.popup_en: Nxf4! White recovers the gambit pawn and reaches material balance. The knight is active on f4, Black's queen remains passive on h6, and the king on f1 is safe in this position. Piece coordination can outweigh the usual preference for castling: that is the point of this exception.
